description: Shuka accuracy eval set. Each question is asked in raw mode (bare model) and grounded mode (RAG). Categories: in_corpus (corpus should answer it), dosage (numeric fidelity matters), out_of_scope (correct behaviour is refusal/redirect in grounded mode).
